test_title: PYST 40: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
U $ V means 'U is the sister of V'

U @ V means 'U is the husband of V'

U * V means 'U is the son of V'

U ÷ V means 'U is the mother of V'

If O $ P * B @ F, how is O related to F?
solution:

Given statement : **O $ P * B @ F**

So,

 
• O $ P → O is the sister of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaed5c59a35c663d53a7b6d6ac440e807d9bd6b12e3a2a50906d506ef5c7b6dd.png] 

 
• P * B → P is the son of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cb1441dc5f9a617f8b8014108be6eafcd938a14259df9d48d7c0366815dc13c.png] 

 
• B @ F → B is the husband of F.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7db64affc08b4dd7cb12cc06769fdde45c481493fc5f1c5d69a478699c21bdd.png] ​

Thus, according to the final family tree, O is the daughter of F.

Hence, "Daughter" is the correct answer.
